```{r}
library(SurrogateRank)
library(ranger)
library(gt)
library(flextable)
library(dplyr)
library(mlr)
library(mlrMBO)
library(tuneRanger)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
#Load in all other objects from FemaleUnivariateScreening

files <- list.files(
  here("MalePreProcessing"),
  pattern = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

for (f in files) {
  obj_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f))
  assign(obj_name, readRDS(f))
}
```

```{r}
risemale <- rise.screen(
  yonemale, #numeric vector of primary response values in the treated group (antibody values at Day 28)
  yzeromale, #numeric vector of primary response values in the untreated group (antibody values at Day 0)
  sonemale, #matrix or dataframe of surrogate candidates in the treated group with dimension n1 x p            where n1 is the number of treated samples and p the number of candidates. Sample ordering          must match exactly yone. (participant id x day 1 gene values)
  szeromale, #matrix or dataframe of surrogate candidates in the untreated group with dimension n0 x p           where n0 is the number of untreated samples and p the number of candidates. Sample                 ordering must match exactly yzero. (participant id x day 0 gene values)
  alpha = 0.05,
  epsilon = 0.25,
  u.y.hyp = NULL,
  p.correction = "BH",
  n.cores = 1,
  alternative = "two.sided",
  paired = TRUE,
  return.all.screen = TRUE,
  return.all.weights = FALSE,
  weight.mode = "inverse.delta",
  normalise.weights = T
)

```

```{r}
risemalesig <- risemale$significant.markers
```

```{r}
#Random Forest

#Cross Validated Random Forest Model using 20 genes as input + plot observed vs. predicted values
#Narrow data frame to 20 columns i.e genes that improved the Base Model
ageandpart <- BaseModel %>% select(age_imputed, maxFC, participant_id)

improvegenematrix<- merge_studytime1_male - merge_studytime0_male

rfgenematrix <- improvegenematrix[,unlist(risemalesig)] # only grabbing improved genes for this matrix

rfgenematrix$participant_id <- row.names(rfgenematrix)

rfgenematrix<- rfgenematrix %>% left_join(ageandpart, by= 'participant_id')  %>% 
  relocate(participant_id, maxFC, age_imputed) %>% select(-participant_id)
# Use existing fold assignments 1-10
```



```{r}
#Random Forest - RISE 

#Setting up the Loop

set.seed(123)
k      <- 10
n      <- nrow(rfgenematrix)
p <- length(colnames(rfgenematrix)[colnames(rfgenematrix) != "maxFC"]) 
folds    <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))
rffoldout   <- data.frame()
rfpredictions <- numeric(n)
dir.create("MaleRISEPrediction/fold_importance_plots_male_rise", showWarnings = FALSE)
importance_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = k, ncol = p)
colnames(importance_matrix) <- colnames(rfgenematrix)[colnames(rfgenematrix) != "maxFC"]

for (i in 1:k) {
  
  train_idx <- which(folds != i)
  test_idx  <- which(folds == i)

  train_data <- rfgenematrix[train_idx,] # Using same training folds as Base Model
  test_data  <- rfgenematrix[test_idx, ] # Using same testing folds as Base Model

  
  # Create mlr task from training fold
  task <- makeRegrTask(data = train_data, target = "maxFC")
  
  # Tune hyperparameters on training fold only
  tuned <- tuneRanger(
    task,
    measure        = list(mlr::rmse),
    num.trees      = 100,
    num.threads    = 1,
    iters          = 30,
    save.file.path = NULL
  )
  
  # Extract best parameters
  best_mtry       <- tuned$recommended.pars$mtry
  best_nodesize   <- tuned$recommended.pars$min.node.size
  best_samplefrac <- tuned$recommended.pars$sample.fraction
  
  # Fit final model with tuned parameters
  fit <- ranger(
    maxFC ~ .,
    data            = train_data,
    mtry            = best_mtry,
    min.node.size   = best_nodesize,
    sample.fraction = best_samplefrac,
    num.trees       = 500,
    importance      = "impurity"
  )
  
  #Summarizing Importance Matrix
  importance_matrix[i, ] <- fit$variable.importance
  
  #Plotting Importance per fold
importance_df <- data.frame(
  feature       = names(fit$variable.importance),
  importance = fit$variable.importance
) %>%
  arrange(desc(importance)) %>%
  slice(1:30)

p_imp <- ggplot(importance_df, aes(x = reorder(feature, importance), y = importance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title    = paste0("Variable Importance - Fold ", i),
    subtitle = paste0("mtry=", best_mtry, 
                      " | nodesize=", best_nodesize, 
                      " | samplefrac=", round(best_samplefrac, 2)),
    x        = "Feature",
    y        = "Impurity Importance"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y   = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "MaleRISEPrediction",
    "fold_importance_plots_male_rise",
    paste0("fold_", i, "_importance.png")
  ),
  plot   = p_imp,
  width  = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi    = 300
)
###
  # Predict on test fold
  rfpredictions[test_idx] <- predict(fit, data = test_data)$predictions
  
  # Compute fold level metrics
  ss_res   <- sum((rfgenematrix$maxFC[test_idx] - rfpredictions[test_idx])^2)
  ss_tot   <- sum((rfgenematrix$maxFC[test_idx] - mean(rfgenematrix$maxFC[train_idx]))^2)
  rsquared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((rfpredictions[test_idx] - rfgenematrix$maxFC[test_idx])^2))
  sd_y <- sd(rfgenematrix$maxFC)
  srmse <- rmse/ sd_y

  rffoldout <- rbind(rffoldout, data.frame(
    fold            = i,
    mtry            = best_mtry,
    min.node.size   = best_nodesize,
    sample.fraction = best_samplefrac,
    srmse             = srmse,
    rsquared        = rsquared
  ))
  
  cat(sprintf("Fold %d | mtry=%d, nodesize=%d, samplefrac=%.2f | R2=%.3f\n",
              i, best_mtry, best_nodesize, best_samplefrac, rsquared))
}

# Overall metrics across all observations
ss_res_total <- sum((rfgenematrix$maxFC - rfpredictions)^2)
ss_tot_total <- sum((rfgenematrix$maxFC - mean(rfgenematrix$maxFC))^2)
overall_r2   <- 1 - (ss_res_total / ss_tot_total)
overall_rmse  <- sqrt(mean((rfgenematrix$maxFC - rfpredictions)^2))
overall_srmse <- overall_rmse/ sd_y


cat(sprintf("\nOverall R2: %.3f | Overall sRMSE: %.3f\n", overall_r2, overall_srmse))

# View per fold tuning results
print(rffoldout)

# ---- AFTER LOOP ---- Importance Matrix

# Summarize importance across folds
importance_df_all <- data.frame(
  feature     = colnames(importance_matrix),
  mean_imp = colMeans(importance_matrix),
  sd_imp   = apply(importance_matrix, 2, sd)
) %>%
  mutate(
    cv = sd_imp / mean_imp,      # stability: lower = more consistent across folds
    se = sd_imp / sqrt(k)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_imp))

# Top 30 by mean importance
top20 <- importance_df_all %>% slice(1:20)

# Plot 1: Mean +/- SD bar plot
ggplot(top20, aes(x = reorder(feature, mean_imp), y = mean_imp)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_imp - sd_imp,
                    ymax = mean_imp + sd_imp),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Features by Mean Variable Importance Across 10 CV Folds",
    x     = "Feature",
    y     = "Mean Impurity Importance ± SD"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
  )

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "MaleRISEPrediction",
    "fold_importance_plots_male_rise",
    "mean_importance_top20.png"
  ),
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

# Plot 2: Stability plot -- mean importance vs CV
# Best features are top-right (high importance) and left (low CV = stable)
ggplot(importance_df_all %>% slice(1:20),
       aes(x = cv, y = mean_imp, label = feature)) +
  geom_point(colour = "steelblue") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Importance vs Stability Across Folds (Top 20 Features)",
    x     = "Coefficient of Variation (lower = more stable)",
    y     = "Mean Importance"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave(
  filename = here(
    "MaleRISEPrediction",
    "fold_importance_plots_male_rise",
    "importance_stability.png"
  ),
  width = 10,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)

# Plot 3: Heatmap of importance per fold

imp_scaled <- apply(importance_matrix, 1, function(x) x / max(x))
top20_features <- importance_df_all$feature[1:20]

heatmap <- pheatmap(
  t(imp_scaled[top20_features, ]),
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  labels_row   = paste0("Fold ", 1:k),
  main         = "Normalized Variable Importance Per Fold (Top 20)",
  filename     = here(
    "MaleRISEPrediction",
    "fold_importance_plots_male_rise",
    "importance_heatmap.png"
  ),
  width        = 12,
  height       = 6
)

# Print summary table
cat("\n--- Top 20 Features by Mean Importance ---\n")
print(top20)

# Most stable important features (low CV, high mean)
cat("\n--- Most Stable Important Features (CV < 0.3) ---\n")
importance_df_all %>%
  filter(cv < 0.3) %>%
  slice(1:20) %>%
  print()


```



```{r}
# Build a dataframe of observed vs predicted
rf_results <- data.frame(
  observed  = rfgenematrix$maxFC,
  predicted = rfpredictions
)

# Compute R²
r2 <- cor(rf_results$observed, rf_results$predicted)^2

# Evaluate with RMSE (correct metric for continuous outcome)
rmse <- sqrt(mean((rfpredictions - rf_results$observed)^2)) # Should this be callign from test data or Base Model

## Standardised RMSE (RMSE divided by standard deviation of response)
sd_y <- sd(rf_results$observed)
std_rmse_rg <- rmse/ sd_y
print(paste("sRMSE:", round(std_rmse_rg, 4)))

# Plot
rfmaleriseplot <- ggplot(rf_results, aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "red") +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = 10,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 1,
    label = paste0(
      "R² = ", round(r2, 3),
      "\nsRMSE = ", round(std_rmse_rg, 3)
    )
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 12) +
  ylim(-1, 12) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(
    x     = "Log Observed maxFC",
    y     = "Log Predicted maxFC",
    title = "Observed vs. Predicted maxFC (Male RISE): Random Forest"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


```

```{r}
saveRDS(
  rfmaleriseplot,

)
```

```{r}
engenematrix <- rfgenematrix %>% select(-c(age_imputed, maxFC))

```


```{r}
#Elastic Net - RISE 

set.seed(123)
k <- 10
n <- nrow(engenematrix)
folds <- sample(rep(1:k, length.out = n))
results   <- data.frame()
y <- rfgenematrix$maxFC
all_preds <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = length(seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)))
all_coefs <- vector("list", length(seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)))
a_idx <- 0

for (a in seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)) {
  a_idx <- a_idx + 1
  enpredictions <- numeric(n)
  fold_features <- numeric(k)
  fold_coefs    <- vector("list", k)

  for (i in 1:k) {
    train_idx <- which(folds != i)
    test_idx  <- which(folds == i)
    x.train <- engenematrix[train_idx, ]
    x.test  <- engenematrix[test_idx, ]
    y.train <- y[train_idx]
    y.test  <- y[test_idx]
    train_scaled <- scale(x.train)
    x.train      <- as.matrix(train_scaled)
    x.test       <- as.matrix(scale(x.test,
                      center = attr(train_scaled, "scaled:center"),
                      scale  = attr(train_scaled, "scaled:scale")))
    fit <- cv.glmnet(x.train, y.train,
                     type.measure = "mse",
                     alpha        = a,
                     family       = "gaussian")
  
   coef_matrix <- as.matrix(coef(fit, s = fit$lambda.min))
  fold_features[i] <- sum(coef_matrix[-1,] != 0)
 
    
# Check what lambda.min looks like across alphas
cat(sprintf("alpha=%.1f | fold=%d | lambda.min=%.4f | features=%d\n",
            a, i, fit$lambda.min, sum(coef_matrix[-1,] != 0)))

    enpredictions[test_idx] <- predict(fit, s = fit$lambda.min, newx = x.test)
    fold_coefs[[i]]         <- coef(fit, s = fit$lambda.min)
    
  }

  all_coefs[[a_idx]] <- fold_coefs
  all_preds[, a_idx] <- enpredictions

  ss_res   <- sum((y - enpredictions)^2)
  ss_tot   <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  rsquared <- 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot)
  rmse     <- sqrt(mean((y - enpredictions)^2))
  sd_y     <- sd(y)
  srmse    <- rmse / sd_y

  temp <- data.frame(
    alpha         = a,
    srmse         = srmse,
    rsquared      = rsquared,
    mean_features = mean(fold_features),
    sd_features   = sd(fold_features)
  )
  results <- rbind(results, temp)
  cat(sprintf("alpha=%.1f | R2=%.3f | sRMSE=%.3f | mean_features=%.1f\n",
              a, rsquared, srmse, mean(fold_features)))
}

# Select best alpha by sRMSE
best_idx           <- which.min(results$srmse)
enpredictions_best <- all_preds[, best_idx]

cat("\n--- Best Alpha Results ---\n")
print(results[best_idx, ])

# Overall metrics for best alpha
ss_res_best  <- sum((y - enpredictions_best)^2)
ss_tot_best  <- sum((y - mean(y))^2)
overall_r2   <- 1 - (ss_res_best / ss_tot_best)
overall_rmse <- sqrt(mean((y - enpredictions_best)^2))
overall_srmse <- overall_rmse / sd(y)
cat(sprintf("Overall R2: %.3f | Overall sRMSE: %.3f\n", overall_r2, overall_srmse))

# Feature selection frequency across folds for best alpha
best_coefs <- all_coefs[[best_idx]]

feature_counts <- lapply(best_coefs, function(cf) {
  cf_mat <- as.matrix(cf)
  rownames(cf_mat)[cf_mat[, 1] != 0]
}) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  table() %>%
  sort(decreasing = TRUE)

feature_df <- data.frame(
  gene           = names(feature_counts),
  folds_selected = as.numeric(feature_counts)
) %>% filter(gene != "(Intercept)") %>%
  arrange(desc(folds_selected))


cat("\n--- Feature Selection Frequency (Best Alpha) ---\n")
print(feature_df)

# Features selected in all 10 folds
stable_features <- feature_df %>% filter(folds_selected == k)
cat(sprintf("\nFeatures selected in all %d folds:\n", k))
print(stable_features)

# All results summary
cat("\n--- All Alpha Results ---\n")
print(results)

```
